title: Rape survivors don’t need court approval to terminate pregnancies up to 24 weeks: Madhya Pradesh High Court

title: Video: Pitbull mauls Patiala couple viewing rental home, woman suffers deep wounds
content: A couple sustained severe injuries after a pitbull attacked them while inspecting a house.  The dog mauled the wife's arm and other body parts, requiring surgery.  Her husband also suffered deep bite wounds while trying to rescue her from the animal.  CCTV footage shows residents attempting to fend off the aggressive dog with sticks.  This incident has prompted discussions about banning aggressive dog breeds in the city.

title: 'Wait for it': KKR posts Hardik Pandya video amid IPL trade buzz - WATCH
content: Mumbai Indians finished ninth in the 10-team IPL 2026 table, with four wins from 14 matches. Under Hardik Pandya, MI have reached the playoffs only once in three seasons. Pandya also had a difficult individual campaign. He scored 206 runs and took four wickets in 10 matches. The 32-year-old has not played competitive cricket since the end of IPL 2026.

title: Months after ‘suicide’ video, Gujarat man kills estranged wife in US
content: A 32-year-old Gujarati man faces a murder charge in Chicago after his wife's death.  Police discovered the woman unresponsive with a stab wound to her neck.  The accused was apprehended at O'Hare International Airport nine hours later.  Family members allege the woman had left her husband twice before this incident.  The couple had relocated to the United States eight years ago from Michigan.

title: Elon Musk to SpaceX employees: You will be the ‘parents’ of AI
content: In a bold step forward, SpaceX plans to enhance its Grok artificial intelligence model by drawing from internal corporate communications. This strategic initiative is designed to cultivate human-centered values within highly advanced AI systems. By tapping into data from its aerospace workforce operations, SpaceX joins several leading tech companies in this data-driven approach.

title: See Trump's posts first? Media groups sue over Truth Social’s paid access
content: Press groups have filed a lawsuit against Trump Media & Technology Group.  They challenge a new service offering paying customers early access to President Trump's posts.  The lawsuit seeks to prevent exclusive release of official government information on the platform.  Trump's firm defends the paid access service, calling the suit an attempt to censor him.  Meanwhile, TMTG shares experienced a decline and reported a significant financial loss.

title: Broken road, fatal fall: Mom of 3-year-old run over in Bengaluru
content: A woman died after falling from a two-wheeler onto a damaged road.  She was then run over by an oncoming mini goods vehicle.  The accident occurred when the two-wheeler skidded after the car ahead braked suddenly.  Residents blamed the poor road condition and civic neglect for the tragic incident.  Police are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the fleeing vehicle and its driver.

title: Months after Dells' $6.25bn ‘gift’, US Treasury sets new Trump Account paycheck rules
content: Under the new guidelines for Trump Accounts, both employers and employees can make contributions towards payrolls. Employers are permitted to add up to $2,500 annually without tax for dependent children, while employees can contribute pre-tax funds directly from their paychecks. In support of this initiative, Michael and Susan Dell committed $6.25 billion to boost child savings. The proposal is currently open for public feedback prior to its finalization.

title: Missile threat made Trump move to smaller US jet during Turkey visit: Report
content: US President Trump was secretly moved to a smaller aircraft due to a missile threat. This extraordinary security operation occurred during his return from Turkey last month. The larger presidential plane was used as a decoy while he traveled separately. Secret Service acted on credible and imminent intelligence regarding the danger. The operation remained secret to conceal the president's movements from potential attackers.

title: California turns old lumber mill into habitat with 420,000 native plants
content: In Northern California, a former lumber mill site has been successfully converted into a vibrant wetland habitat. More than twenty acres of concrete and asphalt have been cleared, allowing for the replanting of native vegetation. This significant ecological project contributes to enhancing the habitats crucial for juvenile salmon and steelhead, yielding promising early results with increased survival rates for coho salmon.

title: Florida completes 2,560-acre stormwater project to protect Indian River Lagoon
content: A groundbreaking environmental restoration initiative in South Florida has marked a pivotal achievement with the completion of the Indian River Lagoon-South C-23/C-24 Stormwater Treatment Area. Designed to effectively capture and purify contaminated runoff before it can harm coastal ecosystems, this facility represents a crucial advancement in the Comprehensive Everglades Restoration Plan and aims to enhance the health of essential estuaries and water quality overall.

title: It's one year to Intel becoming a 'US govt company', what this meant for the chip giant
content: In a landmark decision, the US government has taken a significant stake in Intel, officially becoming its largest shareholder. This strategic development signals a pivotal change in the nation's approach to industrial policy and technology strategy. Aiming to enhance domestic manufacturing and protect vital infrastructure, the move offers a sense of supply chain security, but it raises valid concerns regarding potential political interference.

title: DDA releases 1,224 flats under Karmajeevi Awaas Yojana, with a 25% discount
content: The Delhi Development Authority is launching an exciting offer of 1,224 ready-to-move flats with a remarkable 25% discount in Narela, North-West Delhi. Designed for government employees and qualified professionals, these flats are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Registration kicks off on July 24, 2026, with bookings starting August 15, 2026. This attractive scheme will close on October 30, 2026, or once all units are taken.

title: Kim Pegula makes emotional return to Bills stadium after cardiac arrest
content: Buffalo Bills’ co-owner Kim Pegula made her first public appearance in more than two years at the team’s new Highmark Stadium. Pegula, who suffered cardiac arrest and a brain injury in 2022, walked onto the field with husband Terry and son Matthew. Her return was especially meaningful because she helped plan the $2.2 billion stadium before her health crisis. The emotional appearance marked a significant moment for her family and the Bills.

title: 'We have the upper hand': Sri Lanka captain warns India ahead of Galle Test
content: Sri Lankan captain Dhananjaya de Silva expects a spin-focused Test series against India.  He believes the Galle pitch will gradually favor spinners after initial batting conditions.  De Silva highlighted the importance of player temperament for scoring runs on aging wickets.  He noted Prabath Jayasuriya's strong record at Galle as a key advantage.  India's absence of Jasprit Bumrah is considered a significant loss for them.

title: Oil prices slip as Opec cuts demand forecast; Iran war keeps supply risks alive
content: Oil prices have witnessed a decline due to lowered global demand forecasts and a notable increase in US inventories. Both Opec and the IEA have adjusted their oil demand growth projections downward for the near future. Ongoing tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb Strait are amplifying supply concerns, while negotiations between Iran and the US remain inconclusive.

title: Top stocks to buy: Stock recommendations for today - check list
content: Top stock market recommendations: Indian Bank, DLF, and Polycab India - Aakash K Hindocha, Vice President - Research, Nuvama Professional Clients Group/Nuvama Wealth Management has picked these three stocks.

title: She quit her 9-to-5 to ask what gives life meaning: A story for young professionals
content: Charmie Kapoor’s decision to leave her 9-to-5 after nearly a decade has prompted reflection on ambition, identity and the meaning of success. Without a regular salary or corporate routine, she explored personal projects, creative work, exercise and entrepreneurship. Influenced by nihilism, existentialism and absurdism, Kapoor says her understanding of purpose is evolving. Even after receiving an opportunity from a leading startup, she chose to continue building independently, finding greater happiness in balancing achievement with contentment and freedom.

title: 10 Test defeats & two clean sweeps: But Amit Mishra says 'give Gambhir time'
content: The worst for India under Gambhir's coaching has come in the Tests. In the six Test series that India have played since Gambhir took charge as head coach (one-off Test against Afghanistan not included), they have won just two - against Bangladesh and West Indies at home.

title: South Delhi: Wife kills man with help from lover, tries to pass it off as robbery
content: A horrifying scene unfolded in a quiet home where a man was discovered murdered, initially thought to be the work of a burglar. However, police uncovered a dark plot involving the man's wife and her lover, who conspired to kill him. They sedated him, used electrocution, and artfully manipulated the scene to resemble a robbery.

title: 'Very, very difficult': Can Kuldeep Yadav become India's next spin leader?
content: Kuldeep Yadav has played 18 Tests for India and taken 79 wickets in 34 innings. He has a bowling average of 22.35, an economy rate of 3.53 and a strike rate of 37.9. He has taken four four-wicket hauls and five five-wicket hauls. His best innings figures are 5/40, while his best match figures are 8/113. Kuldeep has also been a successful limited-overs bowler. He has 194 wickets from 121 ODIs at an average of 27.04. In 54 T20Is, he has taken 95 wickets at an average of 13.74.

title: Jana Nayagan BO Day 21: Vijay film holds at Rs 65L, net reaches Rs 194.35 cr
content: Thalapathy Vijay's film 'Jana Nayagan' maintained its steady theatrical run on Wednesday. The movie recorded Rs 65 lakhs in India net collection on its twenty-first day. Its overall India net collection has now reached Rs 194.35 crore. Worldwide gross collections for the film stand at Rs 319.57 crore. The H Vinoth directorial continues to perform well in its third week.

title: LS refers FCRA bill to JPC amid uproar as oppn calls it ‘anti-minority’
content: the decision to refer the bill to a joint parliamentary committee was made by a voice vote . opposition protests called the legislation a BJP design to target minorities and demanded it be junked altogether . the deadline for submission of the report is the first week of winter session .

title: Ready for long debate, can answer any question but oppn doesn’t want it: Shah
content: home minister says govt has nothing to hide over an issue his rivals have used to attack him . he said he was ready for a 24-hour-long debate in parliament at an hour's notice over their charge of police excesses against protesters .

title: Rahul rejects govt’s offer for discussion on NEET protest
